basics.name: Lin Yuan
basics.headline: Backend Engineer · Distributed Systems & Data Platforms
basics.summary: Backend engineer with 6 years of experience building order and data-platform systems; works with Java/Go microservices, MySQL, Redis and Kafka.

bullets: Designed and iterated the order-center service, handling about 2 million orders per day
Reduced P99 latency of the order query API from 800ms to 120ms
Led a 4-person group to split the inventory service and introduced a canary release process
evidence: 2023 performance review: order-center performance report (provided by the user)

bullets: Contributed to the offline job-scheduling module of the data platform
Built task retry and alerting, reducing manual monitoring work
Built a real-time metrics pipeline with Kafka and Flink, giving operations minute-level dashboards

education.role: B.Eng. in Computer Science and Technology
